seed29_pre4_focus.headline: Step 64 to 112 brackets the observed collapse; no intermediate score is available in these aggregates.

planned_pool_coverage.note: Counts derive from the locked driver schedule and event/update totals; class labels were not read from records and realized sampled class counts cannot be verified from these aggregates.

data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.hypothesis: Seed29 warm_pre_sleep_P4 has a marker-level collapse at the last observed checkpoint, not just a class-choice collapse.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.support: At step64 marker accuracy is 99.22%, all EM 25.00%, new EM 0%; by step112 marker accuracy and old/new/all EM are 0%, while new answer NLL is 51.8794 and all answer NLL is 43.0017.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.limit: Evaluations occur only at 0,16,32,64,112. The collapse is only localized to the 64-to-112 interval.

data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.hypothesis: A simple zero-gradient or zero-objective explanation is not supported for seed29 pre4.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.support: Across its 28 events, positive_gradient_updates=672/672, zero_objective_updates=0 and zero_objective_with_zero_gradient_updates=0.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.limit: Positive-gradient counters do not establish useful gradients or stable marker/class representations; inspect gradient norms and intermediate checkpoints.

data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.hypothesis: Teacher order is a high-value control for the seed29 failure.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.support: At step112 seed29 pre4 has zero marker accuracy and zero new EM, while post4 has 98.83% marker accuracy and 49.61% new EM; pre4 uses pre_fast at all 28 events and post4 uses post_fast at all 28.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.limit: Three seeds only; order is bundled with applied-fast timing and outcomes do not establish a causal effect.

data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.hypothesis: Warm receiver correctness is seed-dependent and not universally localized to the receiver.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.support: Selected warm teacher validation and receiver-disabled validation differ by seed; seed29 receiver-disabled old/all validation EM are both 93.75%, while seed17 is 0% and seed43 old is 49.61%. Reset-without-KD controls also vary substantially.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.limit: These are aggregate probes on the development validation split; they do not by themselves identify which component caused a Phase B endpoint.

data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.hypothesis: Event logs expose receiver slot progression but do not directly identify the warm receiver state inside each event.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.support: The run step0 adapter fingerprint matches the warm checkpoint; pre/post P4 event logs record receiver slot 1..28, receiver level 1 and active-slot progression through slot 28. Event teacher fingerprints are per-event and do not match the stored warm teacher fingerprint.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.limit: The initial_student fingerprint is recorded at the first boundary after primary updates, not at warm initialization; event hashes identify states but not their semantic provenance.

data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.hypothesis: Zero-objective events are a real outlier in post4 seed29 and a smaller one in pre4 seed43, but zero-gradient updates remain zero.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.support: Post4 seed29 has 46 zero-objective updates across events (including 12 at boundary108); pre4 seed43 has 4 (1 at28, 3 at32). Both have 0 zero-objective-with-zero-gradient updates.
data_driven_hypotheses_and_limits.limit: These counts are not specific to the pre4 seed29 collapse and do not show that the objective outliers cause endpoints.

highest_value_controls_for_next_probe.control: Paired seed29 pre4 vs post4 replay from the exact same warm checkpoint, primary batch schedule and 24-example event pools; toggle only fast-before-teacher ordering.
highest_value_controls_for_next_probe.readout: Evaluate validation marker accuracy/NLL and conditional class accuracy/NLL after every four-step boundary from 64 through112; retain all three seeds.

highest_value_controls_for_next_probe.control: Add an intermediate no-update scoring branch at each boundary for pre4 seed29 and all-seed matched controls.
highest_value_controls_for_next_probe.readout: Separate marker failure from class failure and identify earliest boundary; keep this branch optimizer/RNG isolated.

highest_value_controls_for_next_probe.control: Log receiver provenance explicitly: warm checkpoint fingerprint, event-start fingerprint, teacher fingerprint, receiver slot, source/sender bank, and reset/applied-fast ordering.
highest_value_controls_for_next_probe.readout: Test whether intended warm receiver/latest state is actually visible to the event and persist slot/class pool counts without article text.

highest_value_controls_for_next_probe.control: Re-run receiver-disabled and reset-without-KD probes with all seeds under identical train/validation scoring and report each class.
highest_value_controls_for_next_probe.readout: Check seed-specific receiver dependence; existing controls show receiver-disabled validation is 0%, 93.75%, and 49.61% old/all across seeds 17/29/43.
